description: Reads the exact shoppingListId returned by get_my_week or create_shopping_list. A week: reference reads app-week requirements with saved servings and current Pantry without saving anything; browser-only ticks, extras and serving overrides are unavailable. It supports read-only review proposals, not update_shopping_list or open_shop_handoff. Otherwise returns the latest saved revision of a shopping list: lines with stable IDs, which are ticked off (excluded) or partly covered, and the revision number that update_shopping_list and open_shop_handoff take. Saved state here supersedes earlier conversation output. Lists expire after 24 hours; retrying an unavailable ID cannot recover it. Recovery creates a new list from the exact known intended menuDraftId, reopening its exact known savedWeekId first if needed. Missing exact references require the user to reopen the intended week; guessed IDs and recent-week substitutions cannot establish the intended plan. Rebuilding does not restore ticks or partial coverage. Read-only. Requires a linked Chop it account.

shoppingListId.description: The exact shopping list to read or update. Never infer the list from an old widget.
